reviews.x: This is a nice set of brushes. Soft bristles that goes through hairs very easily. My daughter has curly hairs so i have always been buying expensive brushes for her. Im surprised to see this brush works perfectly fine for a fraction of price. Im happy with my purchase.

reviews.t: ONLY ONE BRUSH NOT TO AS DESCRIPTION STATES
reviews.x: This was supposed to be 2 pack as it says in the listing but it only came with one. So very misleading and disappointing.
Cheap brush...does not detangle any better . I will give the company 5 stars for refunding me.

I purchased this item for my wife and daughter. They both have long hair and have issues brushing their hair. Always problems with brushing and becoming tangled. They used this product and both said they were very surprised at how good it detangled. My daughter said it has left her hair softer and less tangled. It gets better with each brush. She has very thick and dense hair. She loved the brush. The wife said the same thing. Her hair is softer and looks good on both of them. It lessens the tim

These brushes arrived with crushed bristles due to the ineffective packaging. They feel cheap - like worse than dollar store cheap - in fact the dollar store has some pretty decent stuff and may have a better product than this set of brushes.  I'm surprised to see so many good reviews. I'll be returning this set to find something of better quality.  Update: The seller offered to replace this product, however, I declined due to the quality.

Really great brushes!! Very nice soft bristles! I have long hair - almost down to my waist and I was using a comb to comb it wet and dry... losing a lot of hair in the process! With dtang hair brushes I feel great when I comb my hair! With these hair brushes I look forward to combing my hair because it feels great, it doesn't pull out your hair. Highly recommended!!! LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!
Overall good hairbrush for the price compared to the Wet Brush. I have very thick hair and I’ve noticed the bristles are not as soft as the Wet Brush although they may soften with time.
Great product and good quality. This product do the work I recommend it!  Muy buen producto y excelente calidad. El producto hace el trabajo muy bien lo recimiendo!
Good value for money I have long hairs which tangles so much with this it really works softly untangling my hairs and without too much of pain or hair loss
Love that they don’t pull on my hair or cause hair breakage.

I purchased this brush bc it LOOKS similar to the brush I've used for so many years -- plus the reviews are good. I noticed the rubberized tips were coming off mine & it was time for a replacement. I used the Dtang brush while blowdrying and noticed lots of broken hair on my black pants and top. Plus I pulled a lot out of the brush. This will work for ppl with short, thin hair perhaps, but not for thick wavy hair like mine! I guess I need to go to the beauty supply store after all. Sigh...

I'm not sure how it happen or even if it was my fault, but somehow my girlfriends favorite brush went missing after a day trip to beach and guess who got blamed. So what could be better than replacing the missing brush? Getting TWO brushes so now we have one that never leaves the bathroom! Besides covering my you know what in the future, my girlfriend loves them...

These brushes are lightweight and seem to be pretty sturdy. I was able to untangle my thick hair in the shower very easily. The little nubs on the bristles make it so that my scalp doesn’t get scraped, which is nice. I love that I got 2. I can have one in the shower and one in my gym bag.

I was expecting Two brushes packed in one package but these are two brushes packed individually and wrapped together. Which is quite fine I am using Purple now and I kept Pink for later on. I really like the colors and the grip. Great value for money.

We buy wet brushes and live by them I decided to try these because they were more affordable having 3 little girls you can never have too many brushes my girls love these they prefer them over the more expensive wet brushes

It hurts my kids skin when they brush their hair, I tried it and it does hurt, could have made the little coverings on the tips of the brissels a bit softer maybe. It’s sadly useless for us as my kids will not use them.

reviews.t: hairbrush for wet and dry tangles
reviews.x: This is a nice, soft brush. It's gentle on my scalp and seems to brush through both bed head and wet hair pretty well. I don't seem to leave as much hair in the bristles as I do with my old, hard, stiff bristle brush.

This pulled the same as the conair brush I already have so I sent them back.  It did not get large knots/tangles out any easier, it still got caught in snarls at the ends.  I only used on wet hair.  Returned them.

I liked it but one problem was that it wasn’t really strong and sturdy got other brushes that were better here I needed to put my hand on the top and push down hard but good to use for your kids for camp
These are great brushes. I bought one for each of my kids. The color is true to what the picture depicts them. They are sturdy as well. My kids have thick hair and the brushes have held up real well.
Vivid color, strong brush. Pokey bristles. They scratch my head and are uncomfortable for me. Unfortunately, I bought for my daughter so it is even more so for her. I do not recommend this product.
I love it. They arrived on time and they're exactly what I needed. They don't look like the pins would come off or the foam would split - and they help untangle pretty softly. Happy with this.
So easy on my wet or dry hair. I have natural curl and this slides through nicely. Wanted to get them for my sisters and now they are unavailable. This was an awesome price for 2 brushes.

reviews.t: This is not as soft as the "Wet" brush
reviews.x: I bought this because it seemed like a cheaper alternative to the "Wet" brand brushes.  The bristles are harder and stiffer, not soft like the "Wet" brushes. Returned; not buying again.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these brushes detangle hair effectively, including for long, thick, and curly hair.
Reviewers frequently praise the value for money, noting they work well at a fraction of the price of more expensive brushes.
Several reviewers appreciate the soft bristles and gentle, pain-free brushing that doesn't pull or break hair.
Some reviewers report receiving only one brush instead of the advertised two-pack, or describe the brushes as cheap-feeling with crushed bristles.
A few reviewers note the bristles are not as soft as the Wet Brush or that the brush caused hair breakage.
